source:
@@U04664@@
Beautiful, ravishing children, tell me, please,
aren't you, too, kin to Great 路西法?
You prettiest of the prettiest,
how I long to kiss you!
I think you're going to suit me very well!
How at ease I am, so natural around you,
as if [d seen you a thousand times over.
The more I look, the lovelier you become,
and I more like a common rutting alley cat!
Come to me, come!
Come, just one look at you!
Only one!

@@U04666@@
We're coming! You see?
Why shrink away so?
Closer, closer.
Stay if you can stand it.

@@U04667@@
(The ANGELS hovering about take up the entire stage.)

@@U04669@@
(Pushed forward into the proscenium.)

@@U04670@@
You call us spirits of the damned,
but what about you?
You're the real witch masters,
seducing men and women both!
Ah, what a blasted affair!
Love? Can this be it?
The stuff of love?
My body’s so on fire, I almost feel no
burning pain in my neck!
You sway, you sashay, this way, that way.
Come down, why don’t you,
come, and move those
lovely limbs a bit more profanely!
Oh, I know, I know,
this serious air becomes you,
translation:
@@U04664@@
美丽迷人的孩子们，请告诉我，
你不也是大路西法的亲戚吗？
最漂亮中最漂亮的你
我多么渴望亲吻你啊！
我想你会非常适合我！
在你身边我是多么自在，多么自然，
就好像[见过你一千次。
我越看你就越可爱
而我更喜欢一只普通的发情野猫！
到我这里来，来吧！
来来来，就看你一眼！
只有一个！

@@U04666@@
我们来了！你看？
为何如此退缩？
更近了，更近了。
如果你能忍受的话就留下来吧。

@@U04667@@
（盘旋的天使占据了整个舞台。）

@@U04669@@
（被推到台口上。）

@@U04670@@
你称我们为该死的灵魂，
但你呢？
你们才是真正的巫师大师
男人女人都诱惑！
啊，多么该死的事情啊！
爱？可以这样吗？
爱情的东西？
我的身体如此着火，我几乎感觉不到
我的脖子火辣辣的疼！
你摇摆，你潇洒，这边，那边。
下来吧，你为什么不下来，
来吧，移动那些
可爱的四肢有点亵渎！
哦，我知道，我知道，
这严肃的空气变成了你，
